snippet.title: Pusher
snippet.description:
Welcome to the Pusher YouTube channel! Here you’ll find everything from tutorials about our realtime platform to talks from the developer community. Check out our carefully curated playlists and subscribe to our channel to get updated when we release new content.

At Pusher, we spend our time maintaining reliable and scalable realtime infrastructure so you can spend yours building awesome realtime features. Getting started takes just a few seconds: simply go to https://pusher.com and create a free account. Happy hacking!

Check out the Pusher blog: http://blog.pusher.com/

Follow Pusher on Twitter: https://twitter.com/pusher
